main_text.p: luberrima ex floribus siccatis rorismarini, saluiæ, lauendulę, lilii conuallium, sambuci, hyssopi, rosis siccis, & similibus, quæ vitam sanitatemq; prorogaturo, cumprimis verò politioris literaturæ studiosis, & vt vno dicam verbo, omnibus patribus familiàs tanquam pretiosissimum ad ingenii vires animiq; vigorem custodiendum thesaurum, vnicè commendo. Præstant autem id fotu, olfactu & illitu circa tempora, oculos, os, nares & carpum. Crocata autem omnia præstantiora. Ad extremum, vt tandem lucubrationibus hisce vigiliisq; meis finem imponam, in condimentorum quoq; vsum admitti, & aromata, vt gariophyllos, zinziber, piper, cinnamomū, corticè citri, cardamomū, crocū, macin, &c. non ignorandū est, quib. fuauiter salutariterq; cibi potusq; codiri solent, iisq; innoxiè maximoq; valetudinis comodo vti possum, si moderatè & mediocriter adhibeantur. Immoderatū verò illorū, vsumq; frequentiore, ipsum stomachū viscerąq; int* omnia, præcipuè epar, intolerabili feruore incendere manifestū est, id cp sitis bibēdiq; auiditas indicat. Vbi peßimè sanitati vitæq; cōsulūt, q, dū ardore illū vini ingetib hauftib*, restinguere studēt, igneq; igni addētes, oleuq; flamis, ingētes in corpore cruciatus atq; tumult* excitat, feq; ipsos ad liberali* auidiusq; bibendū, inuitat, proritat, atq; inflammant.

page.notes: Marginal note at right is partly lost in the scan; the printed readings are reconstructed where faint. Several words in the body are doubtful due to the scan quality (e.g. "rorismarini", "hilopi", "sanitatem", "Crocata", "[?]"). Marked spellings like "int*" and "peßimè" are printing forms left as printed.
